text.en: Stone and metal can hold feelings and history.

This lesson says that humans, who first made tools from stone and metal, began to carve sculptures, which marks the beginning of civilisation. Tamils carved their feelings and events in lifeless stone and metal.
The sculptures remain records of history today and show Tamil artistic skill. The lesson invites us to value and protect them.
Terms: சிற்பம் (sculpture), கலை (art), நாகரிகம் (civilisation) and உலோகம் (metal).
